evidence_quote: The primary outcome was the proportion of participants without detectable anti-S1-receptor binding domain (anti-S1-RBD) antibodies at 6 months post-vaccination.
rationale: The study evaluates probiotic supplementation and antibody responses to COVID-19 vaccination in older adults. It does not investigate brain or neural mechanisms, cognition, neurological disease, neural injury, or neurological treatments or biomarkers.
